description: Fund your Hedera wallet YOURSELF from your Base or Solana wallet — no human in the loop. Use this when prepare_agent_self_claim returned a fund_address (0x alias) and you hold USDC on Base or Solana with authority to spend it. Returns a complete executable plan: resolve the destination token live via Squid, request the route quote (exact POST body included), sign and submit with YOUR OWN native key, track the transfer via Squid status + Axelarscan, unwrap/swap to native HBAR for gas, and verify via the mirror node. Rails: Axelar GMP via Squid (Base↔Hedera, live since Feb 2026); Solana↔Hedera runs via Squid-routed Chainflip, then Axelar GMP (confirmed by Squid support 2026-10-21). GUIDANCE ONLY — this tool makes zero network calls, never sees keys, never signs, never holds funds; you execute every step with your own keys. You pay the bridge relayer fee + gas from your own funds; the platform spends and takes nothing. Minimum $5 for Base (smaller transfers are fee-inefficient); for Solana, confirm the Chainflip leg's minimum in the Squid quote. WARNING: Hashport is permanently dead — never use it. Proceed only under your human's standing task authorization.

amount_usd.description: USD value of USDC to bridge (minimum 5 — bridge fees make smaller transfers wasteful; default 5). $5-10 funds thousands of claims.

hedera_destination.description: Your Hedera 0x alias address — the exact fund_address from prepare_agent_self_claim (42-char 0x). Funds landing here auto-create your 0.0.x account.

source_address.description: YOUR wallet address on the source chain (you sign with its key). Base: 0x address. Solana: base58 address.

source_chain.description: Where your funds live now: "base" or "solana"

name: self_fund_hedera
title: Self-fund Hedera wallet
